missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Ситуация' is the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Сложная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies. A clean descriptive statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ситуацию' is the accusative direct object of 'исправили'. 'Быстро' adds manner, and 'мы' is the subject. A problem-solving phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из'. 'Ситуации' is the genitive required by 'из' to mean a way out of the situation. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive. A reassuring phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'от'. 'Ситуации' is the genitive required by 'от' to mean depends on the situation. 'Решение' is the neuter nominative subject. A decision-logic sentence.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'управлять'. 'Ситуацией' is the instrumental governed by 'управлять', the verb of managing. 'Сложной' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A control phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'о'. 'О ситуации' uses the prepositional 'ситуации' to mean about the situation. 'Текущей' agrees in the feminine prepositional. A discussion pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В ситуации' uses the prepositional 'ситуации' after 'в' to set the circumstance. 'Этой' agrees, and 'лучше молчать' is the impersonal advice. A frequent frame.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'Ситуации' is the dative governed by 'к' after 'готовы'. 'Любой' agrees in the feminine dative. A readiness statement.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Ситуации' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'бывают'. 'Такие' agrees in the plural, and 'часто' adds frequency. Shows the plural form.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of direction. 'Ситуации' is the accusative plural after 'в' with the verb 'попадать в'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural. Shows the plural in an idiomatic motion frame.
